notes:
2026-07-20: Merged in 30 rows from the founder-provided 'makeup_artistry_resources.csv' (Section I.4), bringing the file from 1 channel / 0 blogs / 0 books to a full 10 / 10 / 10. Two of the CSV's 10 channels — 'Kiki Makeup (Nigeria)' and 'Binta Beauty (Nigeria)' — could not be matched to a real, confirmable Nigerian MUA YouTube channel ('Binta Beauty' resolved instead to an unrelated Senegalese cosmetics boutique with no YouTube presence).
